description: Rebuild email_guid_auth_compact.py — a lightweight companion to email_guid_auth.py for constrained environments. Must expose the same POST /auth/email-guid interface but using only stdlib + requests. No fastapi/uvicorn import. Standalone daemon with run() method and if __name__ == '__main__': run() entry. Heartbeat to service_health via write_service. Declares '# deps: requests' at top. This is a separate file, not a rewrite of email_guid_auth.py; both can coexist.
